# @process.co/table-client

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40process.co%2Ftable-client)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@process.co/table-client)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/process-co/npm-table-client)](https://github.com/process-co/npm-table-client/releases/latest)

Framework-neutral TypeScript client for bounded, authorized access to the
Process Table v2 API.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Changes in this repository are overwritten by the distribution sync from
> `process-co/proc-app`. Make source changes under `packages/table-client` in the
> monorepo.

See the package README below for installation, authentication, and API usage.
